meta.title: Holiday House Antica – Vidovići, Island of Cres, Croatia
meta.description: Renovated stone holiday house for 6 guests in Vidovići on the island of Cres: 3 bedrooms, 2 kitchens, 2 bathrooms, sea-view balcony, yard and terrace. Peace, nature and a view over the Kvarner.

hero.subtitle: A stone house renovated in 2021, in peace and quiet 280 m above the Kvarner sea.
hero.image_alt: View from Vidovići over the bay and the islands of the Lošinj archipelago

about.title: One of the oldest houses in Vidovići, lovingly restored
paragraphs: Holiday House Antica is one of the oldest houses in the village of Vidovići on the island of Cres. Renovated in 2021, it offers about 145 m² over a ground floor and three upper floors, with stone walls, wooden beams and green shutters that keep the spirit of old island architecture.

The house is rented as a whole and has two living areas that are connected inside, so you can move freely from one to the other. Each has its own entrance, kitchen, dining area, living room and bathroom – ideal for a large family or two families travelling together. Altogether the house offers 3 bedrooms for 6 guests.
In front of the entrance there is a yard and a small terrace with seating for six, and from the balcony on the third floor you can enjoy a beautiful view of the Kvarner Gulf and the Adriatic Sea.

location.title: Peace, silence and a view over the Kvarner
paragraphs: Vidovići lies 280 m above sea level, surrounded by the scent of Mediterranean herbs, silence and unspoilt nature. From the village you have a panoramic view of the bay, of Osoršćica – the highest peak of the island of Lošinj – of the many small islands of the Lošinj archipelago and of the village of Martinšćica.
Cres is reached by ferry from Istria (Brestova – Porozina) or from the island of Krk (Valbiska – Merag); the crossing takes about 25 minutes.

explore.title: What to see on Cres and Lošinj
explore.intro: Vidovići is a great base for exploring the whole archipelago. Distances are approximate, by car.

items.name: Martinšćica
items.text: The nearest seaside village: pebble beaches, restaurants, a shop and a small harbour.

items.name: Lake Vrana
items.text: A unique freshwater lake in the middle of the island and the source of drinking water for Cres and Lošinj, with lovely views from the road.

items.name: Lubenice
items.text: A stone village perched on a cliff 378 m above the sea – one of the most beautiful spots on the Adriatic. The hidden beach of Sveti Ivan lies below.

items.name: Osor
items.text: An ancient little town where Cres and Lošinj almost touch, with a swing bridge and open-air sculptures.

items.name: Valun
items.text: A fishing village with lovely beaches and the Valun Tablet, one of the oldest Glagolitic inscriptions.

items.name: Cres town
items.text: A Venetian old town with narrow streets, a small harbour and a square with a loggia – perfect for a stroll and a coffee by the sea.

items.name: Mali Lošinj
items.text: The largest town of the archipelago: a seaside promenade, Veli Lošinj, Čikat bay and boat trips to Susak and Ilovik.

items.name: Beli & Tramuntana
items.text: A village in the north of the island, surrounded by the ancient Tramuntana forest and known for its griffon vultures.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How Holiday House Antica handles your personal data.

p: This website presents Holiday House Antica, a holiday home in Vidovići on the island of Cres. For any privacy question, contact us by e-mail (the address is at the bottom of this page).
The website has no user accounts, no analytics and no advertising cookies, and it stores none of your personal data on a server.

The inquiry form does not send anything through the website – it only opens your e-mail app with a prepared message. We receive your data only when you send us an e-mail or a WhatsApp message yourself, or when you call us.

We use the details from your inquiry (name, contact, dates, number of guests and message) only to answer it and arrange your stay. We do not sell them or share them with third parties, except where required by law (e.g. the mandatory guest registration in the Croatian eVisitor system).
The website is served by GitHub Pages (GitHub Inc.), which may log visitors' IP addresses for security and operational purposes.
The location map is loaded from Google Maps. Google may process your data and set cookies according to its own privacy policy.
Fonts are loaded directly from this website, without external services.
The website only remembers your chosen language in your browser (localStorage), so that it opens in the same language next time. This never leaves your device.

Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) you have the right to access, correct and delete your data, and the right to lodge a complaint with the Croatian Personal Data Protection Agency (AZOP). To exercise your rights, contact us by e-mail.
